source.scope: Audited working tree; historical observations are not new verification.

findings.observed: Availability replanning sends a partial object into a full-input schema. A central advertised adaptation action cannot work.
findings.expectedInvariant: A calendar patch preserves unchanged constraints and is validated server-side against complete canonical intent.

findings.observed: Replan retention ignores descriptions, completion criteria and other semantic metadata. “Unchanged” tasks can have different saved plan and live execution instructions.
findings.expectedInvariant: Changed instructions or criteria are CHANGED; kept work matches the applied Quest exactly.

findings.observed: Changed-brief generation reuses a session-wide key; a rejection is followed by recovery of an older operation. The user sees an old draft under new intent.
findings.expectedInvariant: Changed intent has a new attempt hash; an old result cannot become its candidate.

findings.observed: Quick generation/confirmation state is not restored with durable intake. Already-confirmed work is offered as a new draft and fails when confirmed again.
findings.expectedInvariant: Restoration displays the applied active revision and receipt, not a confirmable old draft.

findings.observed: Availability presented in Quick is not the availability used for generation, because scheduling context is dropped. The brief is not a truthful preview of model input.
findings.expectedInvariant: Displayed and generated capacity are projections of one effective snapshot.

findings.observed: Classic requiredMinutes differs from default targetMinutes; small plan was 120m in preview but 180m in downstream capacity. Calendar/planning consumers disagree about duration.
findings.expectedInvariant: One approved plannedMinutes and explicit remaining estimate govern execution and capacity; legacy conflicts are recorded.

findings.observed: Classic ignores normal daily capacity and existing scheduled workload. An apparently valid emergency plan adds 360m/326m to two days without explaining conflict or triage.
findings.expectedInvariant: Existing workload and daily ceilings bind; emergency scope needs useful triage.

findings.observed: Classic writes Goal, Quests and chat separately, with no operation identity. Failure between writes can leave partial execution; retries can duplicate it. No partial-write fault injection performed.
findings.expectedInvariant: All linked execution and Goal writes are atomic and repeat confirmation returns one receipt.

findings.observed: Roadmap Quick confirmation displays no milestone content. Review-before-commit exists as a button order, not an informed review.
findings.expectedInvariant: Strategic Roadmap review exposes milestones, outcomes and forecast before confirmation.

findings.observed: Unrepaired critic concerns can become a confirmable plan; final fatal check uses deterministic findings only. The model review stage is not the quality guarantee its progress copy suggests.
findings.expectedInvariant: Unresolved concrete severe findings block sealing; repair success requires verified issue resolution.

findings.observed: Exam preflight uses the 200 stored-item bound while proposals allow 90. Thirty-one unknown/new topics require at least 125 items yet pass POTENTIAL_FIT. Generation cannot satisfy both contracts.
findings.expectedInvariant: Preflight/output/storage/apply share limits; no provider call for a known structurally impossible proposal.

findings.observed: Roadmap input accepts 49KiB at generation but later readers use 32KiB. Valid larger scope can be generated but cannot reliably be edited, confirmed or replanned.
findings.expectedInvariant: A valid permitted artifact remains parsable at every lifecycle boundary.

findings.observed: Quick's success link points to nonexistent `/planner`. The successful journey immediately becomes a 404.
findings.expectedInvariant: Successful confirmation has a supported owned Planner destination on web and mobile.

findings.observed: Classic substitutes synthetic curriculum fallback after research 503 but continues to claim live/official research progress. Users cannot assess source reliability.
findings.expectedInvariant: Provider failure cannot become verified or official research; supported claims retain applicable source evidence.

findings.observed: One covered/confident Exam topic expands into 20 sessions and 15h. Budget/date opportunity is mistaken for necessary study work; repetitive sessions burden the learner.
findings.expectedInvariant: Secure tiny scope receives only useful work; high available capacity cannot justify repetition.

findings.observed: Quick→Advanced does not carry current setup or target the generated revision. Users re-enter information or find a saved plan manually.
findings.expectedInvariant: Optional controls preserve the same accepted intent and current artifact identity.

findings.observed: Mastery Quick requires a date although the mode supports a derived horizon. Longer date fails with a connectivity message, and local field/summary diverge.
findings.expectedInvariant: No-deadline Mastery is valid; bounds failures preserve accepted data and return an actionable typed error.

findings.observed: Failure codes, actionable validator details and recovery paths are suppressed. E1's real failed generation becomes “plan created without draft”; Roadmap stale calendar looks like a generic inability to finish.
findings.expectedInvariant: Failure identifies stage, code, retryability and next action; retained checkpoints are not confirmable plans.

findings.observed: Every on-blur save disables the shared form. Twenty-seven observed intake actions had median 2.865s, p90 5.118s, maximum 14.042s. Ordinary typing becomes a sequence of waits.
findings.expectedInvariant: Typing remains responsive; outdated save acknowledgments cannot replace newer input.

findings.observed: Brief changes do not invalidate visible REVIEW. Date, goal and budget can refer to one brief while Confirm refers to another revision.
findings.expectedInvariant: A material dirty/new intent disables old confirmation before persistence completes.

findings.observed: Four of seven Roadmap outcomes are identical generic defaults; short scope is spread across six months without an earlier-finish choice. Useful checkpoint detail is present in stored data but not fully exposed in review.
findings.expectedInvariant: Concrete outcomes and comfortable early completion replace horizon filling.

findings.observed: Completion/outcome filtering is an English substring/regex gate, then silent fallback. “Build and run” was rejected as unobservable; arbitrary question counts written as words survived while digit counts are rejected. Pedagogical specificity is not consistently preserved.
findings.expectedInvariant: Observable specific instructions survive lexical wording; substantive rejection carries exact diagnostics.

findings.observed: Classic reserves quota before parsing/validating. Early missing-field return and malformed-body exception do not release the reserved unit. Quota failure behavior was not live-tested under limited entitlement.
findings.expectedInvariant: Validation precedes quota reservation; unused reservation settles once after failure.

findings.observed: Capacity/readiness/preparedness defaults disagree across surfaces. Completed work is counted at full planned duration in capacity while intake weighting uses open work; incomplete confidence becomes different assumptions in Quick and Advanced.
findings.expectedInvariant: Actual work and remaining commitments count once; weak signals are not proof of mastery.

findings.observed: Advanced confirmation does not refresh detail immediately. After successful commit the old draft UI remained until reload; copy still said reconciliation was a future flow while Review plan was available.
findings.expectedInvariant: Confirmation response restores authoritative active state immediately.

findings.observed: Modern confirmation defaults createGoal=false, and ordinary Quest Log renders null goals as “Unknown Goal”. Plan/subject context is lost at the execution surface.
findings.expectedInvariant: Confirmed tasks have owned Goal/context and preserve Planner-to-Focus purpose.

findings.observed: Shared selection helpers include STRETCH items, whereas confirmation requires separate stretch promotion. A proposal containing stretch can fail normal confirmation. No live stretch proposal was generated.
findings.expectedInvariant: Only committed activities materialize; contingent/optional work requires explicit requested change.

findings.observed: Failed acceptance flow replaces REVIEW with FAILED, then offers “Accept this and continue”; confirm immediately returns unless phase is REVIEW. That recovery button cannot complete the advertised action.
findings.expectedInvariant: Workspace next actions match durable state; no accept action for an unconfirmable checkpoint.

findings.observed: Usage telemetry prices unknown model IDs at zero. All 18 recorded calls/79,048 total tokens logged $0; active `deepseek-flash` is absent from the rate table, and Classic logs a display name. This is not evidence that generation was free.
findings.expectedInvariant: Unknown provider pricing is null/unknown, not zero; usage and reservations are traceable.

findings.observed: Classic's rest-day rolling is not bounded by the deadline; floating-rest lookup fails open; app timeout is 180s while route maxDuration is 120s. Deadline and deployment failures remain possible. Late scheduling was not reproduced in C2.
findings.expectedInvariant: Rest/exclusions/deadline fail closed and one root deadline constrains provider work.

findings.observed: Unconfirmed Roadmap shows enabled period expansion. The action waits 8.846s only to receive ROADMAP_NOT_CONFIRMED and a generic message.
findings.expectedInvariant: Expansion is admitted only for a current confirmed strategic base and is reviewed through shared apply.

findings.observed: Research/import/Designer budgets and route ceilings are not one shared end-to-end deadline. DEEP research can require multiple long calls through an action route without an explicit maxDuration. Hosted truncation was not tested.
findings.expectedInvariant: Research/OCR/fallback/repair share attempt call, token and deadline budgets.

findings.observed: “Ask Sylf” mode recommendation is a regex heuristic with incomplete extraction. It recognized tomorrow but did not configure the date or written-number hours. The wording overpromises assistance.
findings.expectedInvariant: Natural language is semantically interpreted against context without a narrow command library.

findings.observed: Obsolete chooser/modal code, older rollout reports and eight stale chooser tests coexist with the current workspace. There is no single verified current prose specification.
findings.expectedInvariant: Target contracts, writer inventory and executable fixtures have explicit versions and honest verification coverage.
